This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said agency
has executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been found
satisfactory.

Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was prompt and well documented, and . On that basis the

We confirm that National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. executed the referenced work to our satisfaction. Their
performance on schedule, quality, and safety was commendable.
